description: If equivalent inputs have equal outputs under \(f:A\to B\), its induced quotient map is injective if and only if \(f(a)=f(b)\) implies that \(a,b\) are equivalent. Equivalently, the given relation equals the kernel relation of \(f\).
signature:
Setoid.lift_injective_iff_ker_eq_of_le.{u_1, u_2} {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {r : Setoid α} {f : α → β}
  (hle : r ≤ Setoid.ker f) : Function.Injective (Quotient.lift f hle) ↔ Setoid.ker f = r
